step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor extracted from an LNA circuit, likely serving as the main common-source amplifying device or part of a cascode stage.

paper_reference.title: A 5-GHz Fully Integrated ESD-Protected Low-Noise Amplifier in 90-nm RF CMOS

Voltage Gain.description: Low-frequency or mid-band voltage gain of the amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. With Vth=0.42V and Vbias=0.9V, Vov=0.48V. Id = 0.5 * 270u * (5/0.5) * 0.48^2 = 311uA. gm = 2*311u/0.48 = 1.3mS. With Rd=2kOhm, Gain = gm*Rd = 2.6 V/V = 8.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load resistor/inductor used in the testbench. A 2kOhm load gives ~8.3 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2*pi*Rout*Cout). Rout=2kOhm, Cout~5fF (drain parasitic). f_3dB ~ 15.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The intrinsic bandwidth of the loaded transistor is high, easily covering the 5.5 GHz operating frequency of the paper.

Power Consumption.description: DC power consumed by the amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * Id. VDD=1.8V, Id~311uA -> Power ~ 0.56 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The testbench biases the transistor at a lower current than the full LNA in the paper, resulting in lower power consumption.

Noise Figure.description: Signal-to-noise ratio degradation through the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: NF_min ~ 1 + (f/fT)*sqrt(gm*Rg). For SKY130 at 5.5 GHz, NF_min is typically 1.5-3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires proper source matching to achieve minimum noise figure, which is not implemented in the simple testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, and 3-dB bandwidth of the NMOS transistor configured as a common-source amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for NMOS LNA core
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM1 VOUT N4 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

Vdd VDD GND 1.8
Rd VDD VOUT 2k
Vin N4 GND dc 0.9 ac 1
Vsrc N2 GND 0

.control
op
let power = -i(Vdd) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw WHEN gain_db=gain_3db FALL=1

quit
.endc
